description_en: Queries the high availability (HA) settings of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 查询智能接入网关的高可用配置
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-smart-access-gateway-ha --smart-ag-id sag-pno62188piyc6txxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSmartAccessGatewayHa

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的智能接入网关实例ID
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

BackupDeviceId.description_en: The serial number of the standby SAG device

DeviceLevelBackupState.description_en:
Indicates whether device-based HA is enabled. Valid values:

ON: enabled
OFF: disabled
DeviceLevelBackupState.description_zh:
设备级别备份状态。取值：

ON：开启。
OFF：关闭

DeviceLevelBackupType.description_en:
The deployment mode of the SAG devices that have HA enabled. Valid values:

warm_backup: active-active mode.
cold_backup: active-standby mode.
no_backup: HA is disabled
DeviceLevelBackupType.description_zh:
设备级别高可用类型。取值：

warm_backup：双机热备。
cold_backup：双机冷备。
no_backup：无备份

BackupLinkId.description_en: The ID of the standby connection

BackupLinkState.description_en:
The status of the standby connection. Valid values:

up: available
down: unavailable
BackupLinkState.description_zh:
备份链路状态。取值：

up：链路可用。
down：链路不可用

LinkLevelBackupState.description_en:
Indicates whether HA is enabled to provide standby connections. Valid values:

ON: enabled
OFF: disabled
LinkLevelBackupState.description_zh:
链路级备份状态。取值：

ON：开启。
OFF：关闭

LinkLevelBackupType.description_en:
The HA mode. Valid values:

DedicatedLineBackupMode: Express Connect circuit and SAG.
StandbyMode: active and standby WAN ports.
Off: HA is disabled
LinkLevelBackupType.description_zh:
链路级备份类型。取值：

DedicatedLineBackupMode：专线备份模式。
StandbyMode：双WAN口主备模式。
Off：无备份

MainLinkId.description_en: The ID of the active connection

MainLinkState.description_en:
The status of the active connection. Valid values:

up: available
down: unavailable
MainLinkState.description_zh:
主链路状态。取值：

up：可用。
down：不可用

MainDeviceId.description_en: The serial number of the active SAG device

SmartAGId.description_en: The ID of the SAG instance
